```{r echo =F}
set.seed(1)
```

```{r message = F}
x <- c("berry", "burry", "berry", "berry", "berry", 
       "bury", "berry", "burry", "berry", "berry")

n <- length(x)
B <- 1000
boot_props <- rep(NA, B)
for(b in 1:B){
  x_b <- sample(x, size = n, replace = TRUE)
  boot_props[b] <- sum(x_b == "berry")/n
}

library(tidyverse)
boot_df <- data.frame(bootstrapped_props = boot_props) 
ggplot(boot_df, aes(x = bootstrapped_props)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10) +
  labs(x = "proportions",
       title = "Bootstrap distribution of sample proportions",
       caption = paste0("B = ", B))
```
